_doc: Edges over the baseline progression. Spec: design/quick-specs/progression-and-edges.md. perks: thiên mệnh, stat modifiers on the sheet (effects), on/off flags (as stats with value 1), and one-time birth effects (birth.purity_all). player: what the main character's edge includes. npc: edge score sources and the per-breakthrough chance range (p = base_step + min(score, 1) x (max_step - base_step)).

perks.name: Đạo Cốt Thiên Sinh
perks.desc: Born with Dao bones: every breakthrough comes easier.

perks.name: Bất Diệt Đạo Tâm
perks.desc: An unbreakable heart: a failed breakthrough costs no tu vi and half the tâm ma.

perks.name: Tổ Truyền Linh Điền
perks.desc: An ancestral spirit field: one more plot, herbs age faster.

perks.name: Cổ Ngọc Tàn Hồn
perks.desc: An old jade pendant holds a remnant soul that guides you at each bình cảnh.

perks.name: Thiên Đố Kỳ Duyên
perks.desc: Heaven's favour: more khí vận, and cơ duyên come twice as often.

perks.name: Đan Tâm Thông Linh
perks.desc: A heart attuned to the cauldron: better luyện đan, stronger pills.

perks.name: Thọ Nguyên Dư Dả
perks.desc: A long-lived bloodline: more years to reach the next realm.

perks.name: Linh Căn Thuần Tịnh
perks.desc: A pure root: every owned element is purer from birth, and you cultivate faster.
